title: Unit 8 review: independence
goal: I can use the grammar and words of this unit to talk about the wars of independence and the new republics.

items: I can say what had already happened by 1808 and what the new governments had to do.
I can tell the story of the war in Mexico.
I can describe the campaigns of Bolívar and San Martín.
I can explain why the new republics had debts and ruined economies.
I can say who gained and who gained little from independence.
